en: Changed MCP tasks to work in the terminal without feature-flag fetching (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways, `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`); set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1` to turn them off
zh: 变更 MCP 任务，使其在终端中无需获取功能标志即可工作（Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、LLM 网关、`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`）；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1` 可将其关闭
